name: codex-agents-desktop
description: Native desktop host for the Codex Studio workspace

scripts.start: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec electron .
scripts.dev: pnpm --filter codex-agents-web run build && pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec electron .
scripts.start:hidden: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec electron . --hidden
scripts.package: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec node package.mjs
scripts.package:ui: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec node package.mjs --ui-only
scripts.start:ui: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec electron . --ui-only
scripts.test: pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.config.mjs && python3 -B recovery-test.py
scripts.test:native: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec node test.mjs
scripts.test:server-frames: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec node server-frames-native.mjs
scripts.test:server-access: pnpm exec install-electron && pnpm exec node server-access-native.mjs
